properties.label: Company
properties.description: Name of the issuing insurance company and, if stated, its parent group.
properties.format_hint: issuer name; if a parent group is stated append it after ' | ', e.g. 'ABC Life | ABC Financial Group'

properties.label: Product Name
properties.description: The marketed name of the fixed annuity product as printed on the specification (model name or product title).

properties.label: Product Type
properties.description: The specific annuity type stated by the document (must be 'Fixed' or equivalent wording for this product type).
properties.notes: Record the document's exact short label, e.g. 'Fixed Annuity', 'Fixed Deferred Annuity'.

properties.label: Parties Involved
properties.description: List of contract roles explicitly named in the spec (for example Owner, Annuitant, Beneficiary).
properties.notes: List each role as a short phrase in the order presented.

properties.label: Issue Age Bands
properties.description: Allowed issue age range(s) for the annuity, including any separate bands for categories (if printed as Q/NQ or other).
properties.notes: If a single open-ended maximum (e.g. 'no maximum') is stated, set max_age to null.

properties.label: Suitability Requirements
properties.description: Any suitability or suitability-related requirements the document states (e.g., 'must be suitable for retirement income').
properties.na_means: Document does not state suitability requirements

properties.label: Minimum Initial Premium
properties.description: Minimum first purchase payment required, given per plan category (use category 'All' if no categories are used).

properties.label: Minimum Subsequent Premium
properties.description: Minimum additional purchase payment after the initial premium, per category if stated.
properties.na_means: No subsequent premiums permitted (single premium only)
properties.notes: If the product is strictly single-premium, set as N/A and note means accordingly.

properties.label: Premium Modes
properties.description: Payment modes and whether the product permits single, flexible or periodic premium funding (e.g., 'Single premium only', 'Flexible premiums accepted').
properties.notes: List exactly as the document words funding options.

properties.label: Accumulation/Contract Account
properties.description: Definition of the contract's accumulation or contract value basis used for credited interest and withdrawals (e.g., 'contract value, less surrender charges').
properties.notes: Capture the wording that defines the base on which interest and charges are measured.

properties.label: Declared Interest Rate
properties.description: Any declared (non-guaranteed) interest rates and the period(s) they apply to as stated in the document, and any effective start date.
properties.notes: List rates in the order printed. If no effective date included, set effective_date to null.

properties.label: Guaranteed Interest Rate
properties.description: Guaranteed minimum interest crediting information: share of premium guaranteed (pct_of_premium) and the guaranteed interest rate range and whether it varies by state.
properties.format_hint: {pct_of_premium: float, rate_min: float, rate_max: float|null, varies: boolean}
properties.notes: If a single guaranteed rate is given, set rate_max equal to rate_min.

properties.label: Guarantee Period (Declared Rate Term)
properties.description: The length of time the declared or credited rate is stated to apply before reallocation or reset, and any guaranteed years for that rate.
properties.notes: Use this for multi-year guaranteed declared-rate periods distinct from ongoing 'current rate' statements.

properties.label: Minimum Guaranteed Value
properties.description: Any guaranteed minimum value formula expressed as a percentage of premium or contract value (for example 'guaranteed to return at least X% of premiums paid').
properties.format_hint: {pct_of_premium: float|null, rate_min: float|null, rate_max: float|null, varies: boolean}
properties.na_means: No minimum guaranteed value beyond standard interest guarantees
properties.notes: If guarantee is expressed as a dollar amount, capture it as pct_of_premium=null and include details in notes.

properties.label: Surrender Charge
properties.description: Surrender charge period in years and the charge percentage applied in each policy year. Also record whether a Market Value Adjustment (MVA) applies.
properties.notes: Policy years run in order; include a trailing 0% year if shown. MVA belongs to this property.

properties.label: Market Value Adjustment (MVA)
properties.description: Any textual details about whether an MVA applies, how it is calculated, and the effect (increase, decrease, or both).
properties.notes: If the MVA is fully described in surrender_charge (mva field), set this to 'covered_in_surrender_charge'.

properties.label: Penalty-Free Withdrawals
properties.description: Amount or percent that may be withdrawn without surrender charge or MVA and when it becomes available (for example '10% of contract value annually, after first year').
properties.format_hint: one short phrase: percentage, basis and timing, e.g. '10% of contract value each year, immediately'

properties.label: Surrender Charge Waivers
properties.description: Circumstances where surrender charges are waived (for example nursing home, terminal illness, death, annuitization), listed as printed.
properties.notes: List each waiver condition as a separate item.

properties.label: Death Benefit
properties.description: The death benefit payable as stated (for example 'contract value', 'guaranteed minimum of premiums paid less withdrawals', or other formula).
properties.notes: Capture the precise formula or basis used to compute the death benefit.

properties.label: Living Benefit Riders
properties.description: List of optional or included living benefit riders referenced (for example lifetime income rider, LTC rider), as named in the document.
properties.notes: Include riders even if available for an additional charge.

properties.label: Annuitization Options
properties.description: Annuitization payout options and forms the contract offers (for example life only, joint life, period certain), as printed.

properties.label: Contract Surrender Value Basis
properties.description: If the document states a formula or guaranteed minimum for the surrender value in dollar terms, capture the amount and the basis (for example 'percentage of contract value' or 'contract value less surrender charge').
properties.na_means: No separate guaranteed dollar surrender value stated
properties.notes: If only a formula is given, amount may be null and basis filled; if only percent shown use amount as percent number and basis as 'percent of contract value'.

properties.label: Interest Crediting Methods
properties.description: Number of indexed and fixed crediting strategies available. For a pure fixed annuity this typically shows fixed strategies; provide counts for both indexed and fixed.
properties.notes: If the product has only fixed strategies set indexed to 0.

properties.label: State Approvals
properties.description: US states (and DC) where the product is NOT approved, or where it is approved if only that list is given.
properties.notes: Record which mode the document uses.

properties.label: Product Effective Date
properties.description: Effective date or issue start date for the rates or product terms as stated in the document.
properties.notes: If only month/year provided use first day of month and note this in 'notes'.

properties.label: Beneficiary / Ownership Changes
properties.description: Procedures and restrictions stated for changing owner or beneficiary, including any forms, timing or limits.

properties.label: Claim Filing Requirements
properties.description: Any deadlines, required forms, or timelines for filing death or income claims as stated in the document.
properties.na_means: No claim filing limits or special requirements stated

properties.label: Other Charge
properties.description: Any charge or deduction that is NOT captured by another charge property (excludes surrender charge, MVA, product fee, annual contract fee and rider charges).
properties.na_means: Document states no other charges apply
properties.notes: Never return 'N/A' unless the document explicitly says no other charges exist. If nothing described, state 'not_found'.

properties.label: Product Fee
properties.description: Any recurring or one-time explicit product-level fee stated (amount and the basis it is measured on, such as 'per contract' or 'percent of account value').

properties.label: Withdrawal Limits / Minimums
properties.description: Any stated limits, minimum amounts, or timing restrictions on withdrawals (for example minimum dollar amount per partial withdrawal or required notice period).

properties.label: Form Numbers & Disclosures
properties.description: Identifiers for policy forms, rider form numbers, and required disclosures listed in the spec.
properties.na_means: No form numbers or disclosure IDs provided
properties.notes: List each form or disclosure identifier exactly as printed.
